jupas.shortDescription: an class="before_label">Short Description The Diplomacy and International Studies programme is an interdisciplinary programme jointly offered by the Faculty of Social Science and the Faculty of Law, leading to a Bachelor’s degree in Social Science. In response to the expeditious developments in geopolitics and international diplomacy, the programme is designed to cultivate high-level talents equipped with a global perspective, an international mindset, strong intercultural competence, and the ability to excel in international organizations and diplomatic settings. Emphasizing the integration of theory and practice, the Programme offers a multidisciplinary curriculum covering diplomacy, international governance, law, regional studies, and interpersonal and intercultural competence. In addition, students will gain practical experience through internships at embassies, consulates, and international organizations, along with professional training at the China Foreign Affairs University. Students will also participate in overseas exchange, ensuring exposure to learning experiences in both China and international locales.

The LS level will not be considered in the calculation of admission scores. Note 3 : The two subjects may include: (i) 2 elective subjects; or (ii) 1 elective subject and Mathematics (Extended Part) Module I or Module II or Other Language subjects (A2 or above in French / German / Spanish; or N3 or above in Japanese; or Grade 3 or above in Korean; or Grade E or above in Urdu). (iii) For Integrated Science or Combined Science subject(s) taken in 2023 or before, a Level 3 or above will be considered as an unspecified elective subject where applicable. Note 4: "Attained with Distinction I/II" in Applied Learning subjects will be accepted by some programmes as an extra subject for awarding bonus points. For details, please click here . cuhkAdmission.introduction: Jointly offered by the Faculty of Social Science and the Faculty of Law, the Diplomacy and International Studies Programme is an interdisciplinary programme leading to a Bachelor’s degree in Social Science. In response to the expeditious developments in geopolitics and international diplomacy, the Programme aims to nurture high-calibre talent equipped with a global perspective, an international mindset, strong intercultural competence, and the ability to excel in international organizations and diplomatic settings. Through cross-faculty collaboration, students will receive a comprehensive education in diplomacy, international governance, law, regional studies, and interpersonal and intercultural competence. This collaborative model also ensures that students gain a well-rounded understanding of international affairs and diplomatic practices from multiple perspectives.
cuhkAdmission.careerProspects: Graduates of this programme are expected to become diplomatic talents well-versed in international affairs while simultaneously carrying a focused understanding of China. The Programme prepares graduates for careers in both political and public diplomacy, while also opening doors to a wide range of sectors including: Government Organizations International Organizations Multinational Corporations Policy Think Tanks Consulting Firms Local and International NGOs Cultural and International Exchange Organizations Teaching and Research in Universities Mass Communication/ Public Relations Postgraduate studies If you are interested in this programme, please review the application requirements and deadlines specific to the respective admission scheme to increase your chances of getting accepted.
